His first club, at the age of 14, was Flexeiras, a local amateur team. Santos joined Botafogo of Rio, made his debut for the side in March 1948, and gained his first cap for Brazil the following year in the South American Championship.

notes: Pelé-era peer. Professional senior start is Botafogo in 1948; the earlier Flexeiras amateur team is excluded. Wikipedia gives 1948–1964; the Guardian explicitly dates his Botafogo debut to March 1948, and Globo corroborates his final match in the 1964 Carioca. No amateur or post-playing roles included.

name: Pepe

sources.excerpt: Aos 19 anos, no dia 23 de maio de 1954, em uma partida diante do Fluminense, no Pacaembu, válida pelo torneio Rio-São Paulo, entrou no lugar de Boca, substituto do seu colega de time em São Vicente, Del Vecchio. O resultado não foi favorável ao Peixe, que acabou derrotado por 2 a 1.

No dia 19 de março de 1969, Pepe usou o manto alvinegro pela última vez como jogador. Em uma partida válida pelo Campeonato Paulista, substituiu Douglas no triunfo sobre o América de São José do Rio Preto por 2 a 1.

notes: Pelé-era peer, José Macia (born 1935), not the Portuguese defender. Entire professional playing route is Santos. Club history establishes first-team debut on 23 May 1954 and last playing appearance on 19 March 1969; the 3 May 1969 farewell lap was not another playing spell. Youth from 1951 and coaching from 1969 onward excluded.

On 10 July 2024, Coutinho re-joined boyhood club [Vasco da Gama](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vasco_da_Gama_F.C. "Vasco da Gama F.C.") on a season-long loan.[\[109\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philippe_Coutinho#cite_note-109) On 4 July 2025, the move became permanent after he reached an agreement to terminate his contract with Aston Villa.[\[110\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philippe_Coutinho#cite_note-:1-110)[\[111\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philippe_Coutinho#cite_note-111) On 18 February 2026, Coutinho left Vasco citing pressure from fans and mental exhaustion.[\[112\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philippe_Coutinho#cite_note-112)

Coutinho returned to Barcelona with the arrival of new coach [Ronald Koeman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ronald_Koeman "Ronald Koeman").[\[99\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philippe_Coutinho#cite_note-99) On 4 October 2020, he scored his first goal of the [2020–21 season](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2020%E2%80%9321_FC_Barcelona_season "2020–21 FC Barcelona season") in a 1–1 draw against Sevilla.[\[100\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philippe_Coutinho#cite_note-100) On 29 December, he suffered a knee injury in a 1–1 draw against [Eibar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SD_Eibar "SD Eibar") and missed the remainder of the season.[\[101\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philippe_Coutinho#cite_note-101)
